visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and a blue patterned fleece jacket stands in front of a car in an outdoor parking area. She waves her right hand at the camera while holding a light green water bottle in her left hand. The background features a green field and several high-rise buildings under an overcast sky. (2) She moves to the rear of the black car and opens the trunk, revealing a large green and black tennis bag with the 'Wilson' logo. She begins to interact with the contents of the bag. (3) She takes out a pair of black and blue athletic shoes, holding them up to show the camera. She then picks up another pair of white and red sneakers. The lighting is natural and flat due to the cloudy weather. (4) The woman leans over the open trunk and pulls out a black tripod and several tennis rackets. She demonstrates how the rackets are stored inside the bag's compartments. (5) A brief scene transition shows the woman from behind on a tennis court at night, wearing black athletic gear and hitting a tennis ball. (6) Returning to the car, she pulls out a specific tennis racket with a black frame and light blue strings, pointing to a small pink heart-shaped accessory near the handle. (7) She reaches into the bag again to retrieve a small snack package and a drink, showing them briefly before placing them back. (8) She struggles slightly to zip the large bag closed, then lifts it onto her shoulder, showing its significant size relative to her body before walking away from the camera.
